{{Quote|For twenty thousand years, my order has fought the nests. We know their hibernation cycles, the secrets of their Joiners.|Chanya Medaal|<ref name="TOR:TDP">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Devouring Plague|Alderaan}}</ref>}}
The '''Order of Extermination''' was a group that resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and had existed for twenty millennia. They were completely dedicated in dealing with the threat of the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] that slept underground. These individuals abandoned their ties to the noble houses and instead kept a vigilant watch over the insectoid aliens during their centuries-long sleep. Whenever the Killiks awoke, the Order was tasked with eliminating the threat through the use of fire.

Its members were known as Knights of the Order of Extermination and believed in the [[First Huntsmen]], [[Codex Chitinous]] along with the [[Blood of Aldera]]. One of their ritual greetings were ''"Ventadya droth, qe no fora."'' They held a significant amount of lore regarding the Killiks such as how to use the scent of [[chanmasu]] herbs to discourage Killiks. Knights of the Order completely abandoned ties to the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] houses and worldly pursuits in order detach themselves from possible distractions to their mission.

By the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era, the Order had been reduced to only a few individuals. In this time, the mythical [[Soros|Black Hive]] had awoken and began eliminating entire armies of [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanians]]. This saw [[Chanya Medaal]] of the Order of Extermination ally with agents of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in [[House of Thul]] to defeat this Killik threat by targeting the [[Joiner]]s.
